title: 2025 Topps Series 1 Topps All Star Rookie Paul Skenes Pittsburgh Pirates Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The 2025 Topps Series 1 Paul Skenes All Star Rookies trading card features the talented player from the Pittsburgh Pirates in Major League Baseball. Made of sturdy card stock, this original card is part of the Topps All Star Rookie set for the 2025 season. With a 20 Pt. thickness, this baseball trading card is a sought-after collectible for fans and collectors alike, showcasing Skenes as a rising star in the MLB World Series. A valuable addition to any sports card collection, this card is a must-have for fans of the Pittsburgh Pirates and baseball enthusiasts alike.
